core_obligations: Equivalence of (1), (2) and (3): the number of irreducible components of quasi-compact opens is local in the smooth topology, so it may be checked on a single presentation or on all smooth presentations, and the space-level formulation is the same condition (proof lines 10217-10224)
(4) implies (1): a quasi-compact stack smooth over the given one has finitely many irreducible components, which specialises to the chosen presentation (proof lines 10225-10227)

(1) implies (4): present a quasi-compact smooth test object by an affine scheme, whose finitely many irreducible components map surjectively and continuously onto the space of the test object, so the latter has finitely many components as well (proof lines 10228-10232)
proof_roadmap: (1)⟺(2)⟺(3)：不可约分支的个数在光滑拓扑下局部，且代数空间层面的表述与之一致。
(4)⇒(1)：准紧的光滑对象分支有限，特化到给定展示。
(1)⇒(4)：把准紧光滑对象用仿射概型满光滑展示，V 分支有限且 |V| → |Y| 满连续 ⇒ |Y| 分支有限。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives four equivalent preparations for the existence of a normalization, all expressing that quasi-compact opens of smooth presentations have finitely many irreducible components (author lemma at source lines 10197-10215, label lemma-prepare-normalization). The proof (source lines 10217-10233) uses the smooth locality of the number of irreducible components for the first three conditions and the presentation of a quasi-compact stack by an affine scheme for the equivalence with the fourth (proof lines 10217-10232). The locality argument and the affine presentation are the substance. H3.
